name: io.github.setluca/luca-mcp
description: SetLuca DM sales from any MCP client: 209 API tools and 15 task tools for leads, replies, and calls.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SetLuca developer API key, from Settings, Developer API keys in SetLuca.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Alias for LUCA_API_KEY. Used only when LUCA_API_KEY is not set.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: SetLuca API origin. Defaults to https://api.setluca.com.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_AUTH_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Header used to send the API key. Defaults to x-api-key.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default workspace id for every call.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_WORKSPACE_SLUG
environmentVariables.description: Optional default workspace slug for every call.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long one API attempt may run before it is cancelled and retried. Defaults to 30000.

environmentVariables.name: LUCA_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: Which tool surface to register. Defaults to full.
